original_title: US reviewing 'every' green card from 19 countries after capital attack

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Administrative review of green card holders from 19 designated countries, focusing on vetting procedures. No direct threat to assets, cargo, aviation, or personnel identified, but potential for increased scrutiny at borders/ports of entry.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Possible minor delays in processing for individuals from affected countries at airports and border crossings; no operational disruptions expected.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Long-term increase in vetting rigor may indirectly affect cross-border logistics and personnel movement if procedures slow processing times or heighten tensions.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Minimal immediate impact; monitor for secondary effects such as protests or targeting of transport infrastructure, though unlikely.
